metadata.description: Curated suite of HumanLayer skills and plugins for Claude Code: visual PRs, diagrams/visualizations (show-me), CLAUDE.md optimizer, React prop narrowing, iterated agentic loops, and control loop design.

plugins.name: humanlayer
plugins.description: Unified bundle of all 6 HumanLayer skills and slash commands: show-me, visual-pr, improve-claude-md, narrow-react-prop-types, build-iterated-agentic-loop, and design-control-loop. Invoke as humanlayer:<skill-name> or /<command>.

plugins.name: show-me
plugins.description: Explain the current topic with concise diagrams, code-shape sketches, and focused HTML artifacts

plugins.name: visual-pr
plugins.description: Create or update a pull request with a concise visual outline for reviewers

plugins.name: improve-claude-md
plugins.description: Rewrite a CLAUDE.md file using <important if> blocks to improve instruction adherence

plugins.name: narrow-react-prop-types
plugins.description: Narrow React component prop types to match live code paths

plugins.name: build-iterated-agentic-loop
plugins.description: Build a repo-local skill plus an iterated coding-agent workflow, prompt, and memory file

plugins.name: design-control-loop
plugins.description: Interview the user to design an agentic control loop (sensor, controller, actuator under disturbances) for their codebase, then build it as locally-runnable components plus a scheduled coding-agent workflow
